title: Bridging the Gap in Ophthalmic AI: MM-Retinal-Reason Dataset and OphthaReason Model toward Dynamic Multimodal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2508.16129v5 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have recently demonstrated remarkable reasoning abilities under reinforcement learning (RL) paradigm. However, most existing multimodal medical reasoning models focus on basic reasoning, which refers to shallow inference based on visual feature matching. In contrast, real-world clinical diagnosis extends beyond basic reasoning, demanding complex reasoning that integrates heterogeneous clinical information (such as chief complaints and medical history) with multimodal medical imaging data. To bridge this gap, we introduce MM-Retinal-Reason, an ophthalmic multimodal dataset covering the full spectrum of perception and reasoning. Specifically, it is the first dataset in ophthalmology to encompass both basic and complex reasoning tasks with Chain-of-Thought (CoT) trajectories, aiming to enhance visual-centric reasoning and emulate realistic clinical decision-making. Building upon MM-Retinal-Reason

translated_title: 弥合眼科人工智能的差距：面向动态多模态推理的MM-Retinal-Reason数据集与OphthaReason模型
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）近年来在强化学习（RL）范式下展现出了卓越的推理能力。然而，现有的大多数多模态医学推理模型都聚焦于基础推理，即基于视觉特征匹配的浅层推断。相比之下，真实世界的临床诊断超越了基础推理的范畴，需要将异构临床信息（如主诉和病史）与多模态医学影像数据相整合的复杂推理。为了弥合这一差距，我们推出了MM-Retinal-Reason，这是一个覆盖感知与推理全谱系的眼科多模态数据集。具体而言，它是眼科领域首个同时涵盖基础与复杂推理任务并附带思维链（CoT）轨迹的数据集，旨在增强以视觉为核心的推理能力并模拟真实的临床决策过程。基于MM-Retinal-Reason……
tldr: 该论文提出了眼科领域首个同时涵盖基础与复杂推理任务（附思维链轨迹）的多模态数据集MM-Retinal-Reason及OphthaReason模型，以弥合现有医学AI仅能进行基于视觉匹配的基础推理与真实临床诊断所需的异构信息整合复杂推理之间的差距。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MM-Retinal-Reason, the first ophthalmic multimodal dataset encompassing both basic and complex reasoning tasks with Chain-of-Thought trajectories, along with the OphthaReason model, to bridge the gap between existing medical AI limited to basic visual-matching reasoning and the complex reasoning integrating heterogeneous clinical information required for real-world clinical diagnosis.
